description:
Return the last nightly-precomputed result for one registered preset screen.

    `name` must be one of the names returned by list_preset_screens. A preset that has never
    been computed yet returns an empty result with reason_code "no_data". Cache-only — this is
    the stored output of an equivalent screen_stocks(filters=...) call, not a live query.
name: run_preset_screen
